name: Castle Ravenloft
arrival: The road ends in a stone forecourt beneath dark towers. The barred doors admit neither the wind nor an invitation.
look: A dry fountain stands beneath the windows. Tracks stop at the great doors, but the return path is clear.

name: Krezk
arrival: A sentry watches from the wall above a sheltered gate approach. Smoke rises from houses beyond the palisade.
look: Fresh timber braces the gate. A covered bench offers a place to wait, while the abbey roofs show above the town.

name: Old Bonegrinder
arrival: A leaning windmill turns above the trees. Flour dust clings to a stone beside the path, though no worker comes out.
look: The mill's shutter knocks against its frame. A worn track circles the building and returns to the road.

name: Argynvostholt
arrival: A ruined manor rises above a broken courtyard. Fragments of a dragon crest remain over the closed entrance.
look: Cold air passes through empty window frames. The outer stones offer a view of the valley, but the manor's story lies beyond these grounds.

name: Tsolenka Pass
arrival: The pass narrows between pale rock and a wind-scoured gate. A path crosses the exposed approach.
look: Snow catches in the joints of the parapet. From this lookout you can trace the lower roads before returning.

name: Ruins of Berez
arrival: Water gathers between the remains of a drowned street. The arrival path reaches a small patch of firm ground.
look: A doorway leans over reeds where a house once stood. The flooded town beyond is still waiting for its own chapter.

name: Van Richten's Tower
arrival: A narrow approach reaches a solitary tower beside the water. Its dark windows face the far bank.
look: An empty mooring creaks against the shore. You can inspect the grounds, but the tower's door remains closed.

name: Wizard of Wines
arrival: Rows of tired vines lead to the winery yard. Barrels wait under an awning beside the shut doors.
look: A cart has left deep ruts in the soil. The vineyard paths are quiet; the troubles of the winery are a story still to come.

name: Amber Temple
arrival: A severe stone facade emerges from the high mountain mist. The exposed approach ends at a sealed entrance.
look: Pale deposits mark the stone around the doorway. The outer terrace is safe to examine; the temple depths remain beyond this visit.

name: Yester Hill
arrival: A ring of weathered stones crowns the rise. Wind bends the grass along an open path to the crest.
look: A dead branch has been wedged into one of the stones. The hill is quiet during this visit, with no rite or battle underway.

name: Werewolf Den
arrival: Tracks converge outside a dark opening in the hillside. The arrival trail ends on a shelf of bare stone.
look: The cavern carries sound farther than you expect. The den's interior and its inhabitants belong to a later adventure.

name: Gates of Barovia East
arrival: Stone sentinels stand above the eastern road. Mist catches against ironwork and spills between the open approaches.
look: Beyond the gate the road fades into the valley's border. This visit neither frees you from Barovia nor changes the current journey.

name: Gates of Barovia West
arrival: An old gate marks the western stretch of the valley road. Moss has softened the faces carved above it.
look: Wheel marks cross the worn threshold. The side path returns to the same road you followed in.

name: Svalich Woods
arrival: Dark pines close around a small trail clearing. The road remains visible through a gap in the branches.
look: The forest floor holds old tracks and fresh needles. Nothing here demands a fight, and no hidden timer starts when you enter.

name: River Ivlis
arrival: A bank path reaches the cold Ivlis. Water moves past the stones without revealing what lies beneath.
look: A snag of driftwood turns slowly in the current. The marked crossing is the way back; the deep channel is impassable.

name: River Ivlis Crossroads
arrival: Several tracks meet beneath a weathered roadside marker. One points toward Barovia; another bends into the trees.
look: Names have been cut over older names in the stone. The junction offers bearings without advancing the escort or church investigation.

name: Tser Falls
arrival: Spray drifts across a stone approach above the falling water. The river sounds louder than any voice.
look: A sheltered ledge looks down the gorge. Keep to the clear crossing; the falls themselves cannot be entered.

name: Black Carriage
arrival: A black carriage waits at a roadside turnout. Its door is closed, and no driver offers a bargain.
look: The wheels are clean despite the mud. For now the carriage is a landmark; it will not transport you or begin an invitation scene.

name: Gates of Ravenloft
arrival: The road rises to a gate beneath the castle's shadow. The open outer approach gives way to heavy ironwork.
look: Through the bars you can make out the forecourt beyond. The castle's larger adventure remains ahead, but you can return to the valley.

name: Lake Zarovich
arrival: The northern lake spreads beyond a quiet landing. Vallaki lies behind the tree line to the south.
look: A rope has been looped around a shore post. The water remains a boundary; this arrival scene offers no boat trip or rescue quest.

name: Mount Baratok Trail
arrival: A narrow trail reaches a cold mountain shelf. The northern ridge disappears into low cloud.
look: From the shelf the lake looks like a dark plate between the woods. No hidden mountain encounter is triggered by this visit.

name: Luna River Crossroads
arrival: A fork in the western road overlooks the river country. Old markers point toward the lower valleys.
look: The wheel ruts divide around a mossy stone. Follow the marked road to leave this quiet stopping place.

name: Raven River Crossroads
arrival: A roadside clearing opens where the western tracks divide. The river can be heard beyond the trees.
look: A raven settles on a leaning marker, then takes flight. The branches of the road remain available in either direction.

name: Lake Baratok
arrival: A short shore trail opens toward the western lake. The water is still enough to hold the mountain's outline.
look: Reeds hide the shallows. This bank is a viewpoint, with the tower and other western destinations reached by their own road markers.

name: Lake Luna
arrival: The lower lake lies beneath the western ridges. A small landing interrupts the reeds along the bank.
look: Water reflects the pale sky between mountain shadows. The dry trail leads back to the valley roads.

name: Mount Ghakis Lookout
arrival: The southern climb reaches a lookout above a sweep of pale stone. The higher summits remain lost in cloud.
look: The lower pass and the temple approach can be traced from here. This is a stopping place, with no summit trial or permanent penalty.
